subject: Apply a VHS tape degradation effect: add horizontal sync jitter and tape-dropout scan lines, introduce chroma smearing with color bleeding especially on high-contrast edges, add tracking noise artifacts along the bottom of the frame, desaturate slightly with a warm magnetic tape hue shift, introduce faint white noise and brief random static bursts, add a faint VHS time-code or tracking bar artifact. The result should look exactly like a well-watched VHS dub recorded in the 1980s.
